legacyTitle: Maalhos Island | Baa Atoll, Maldives - Authentic Island Experience

faqs.question: How do I get to Maalhos Island?
faqs.answer: The most convenient way to reach Maalhos is by domestic flight from Male to Dharavandhoo Airport (30 minutes), followed by a 25-minute speedboat transfer. Public ferry service operates weekly from Male (approximately 9 hours journey time).

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Maalhos Island?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Maalhos Island is during the northeast monsoon season (December to April), which brings dry, sunny weather with lower humidity and calmer seas.
